correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Petersen graph as KG(5,2), its fifteen graph edges and all 32768 edge masks; verified matching cardinality counts (1,15,75,145,90,6). Independently reproduced the specified 160-pair discrete Morse matching, topologically sorted all 975 directed Hasse incidences on the 331 nonempty faces, and obtained exactly one critical vertex, five critical 2-cells and five critical 3-cells. Independently computed the signed integral gradient-path boundary from all five critical 3-cells to all five critical 2-cells, finding an identically zero 5×5 matrix (not just zero modulo a prime). Thus Hurewicz π2=Z5 makes every S2 attaching map null and the integral wedge follows. For each of all 120 permutations in S5, independently computed oriented chain traces and the 79-dimensional im(d3) finite-field trace; prime1000003 > 2×79 gives unique integral trace lifts, yielding H2=sgn(g)·fixed_points(g) and H3=choose(fixed_points,2)+two_cycles-fixed_points. Their rational characters identify the two named modules; no claim about integral S5 lattice decomposition.
